description: This file implements a function to check if a specific keyboard key is currently pressed, interfacing with Lua. It handles input arguments, converts string inputs to key codes, and interacts with an array representing keyboard state.

methods.name: int keyIsDown(lua_State * L)
methods.description: Checks if a specified key is pressed; accepts either an integer key code or a string representing the key, and returns a boolean indicating the key's state.
